name: Acedia
source:
The story of Teo, a 17 year old boy forced to move into a decrepit apartment complex lost in the forest, take care of his very ill mother while discovering new people and environments.

Gradually, Teo begins to witness things that are out of the ordinary. A young boy tells him a strange story, and a sly old man seems to be going back and forth between the residence and the dephts of the forest.

What secrets does this place hold ?
